reviews.text: Given that it was an emergency and we had to wait 6 hours, I understand there was only one doctor and one nurse, but I think they should have done triage and provided care according to the emergency, instead of giving a minimum 6-hour wait.
I have no words to describe the exceptional behavior of ALL the professionals from all areas who work in this unit. I owe them my Sally's life! Thank you so much.

The experience used to be positive, but every time I go there with a scheduled appointment, I end up waiting for 2 hours or more. In addition, I spend almost an hour waiting to be attended to by them on the phone, with the excuse that they are always busy with emergencies. It's always the same excuse, and they're not trying to improve.

The price is lower than what you pay in other clinics, but still expensive for our Portuguese reality. In 17 days I paid over 1400 euros. I brought my cat home because it would have been impossible to pay much more; my kitten will go there for consultations. Regarding the veterinarians and people who work there, I only have good things to say; they are very kind, and my little one was very spoiled. I advise anyone with young animals to get insurance; mine was already 14 years old and I had never thought about it. I know there are people dying of hunger in the world, and I used to be critical of spending so much on an animal, but when it happens to one of our own, the heart rules over reason.

Between arriving with my cat in urgent need and being advised to go to another hospital because the emergency room no longer has the capacity to receive animals, calling and having an incredibly long wait to get through, and never having any available appointments in the near future.
It's impossible to continue having my cats treated at this place.

Horrible, it's not urgent at all. It's closed with a sign saying the average waiting time is 6 to 8 hours.

Well, if it's an EMERGENCY, it's because you don't have to wait 6 to 8 hours.

It's a disgrace, ill-intentioned.

Google says they're open 24 hours, but in reality they're closed and have a 6 to 8 hour wait precisely so that nobody goes. Someone with an emergency doesn't wait 6 hours. A disgrace, disgusting attitude.

Good morning,
This clinic has a very mediocre service. It had a good reputation, but currently has a terrible outlook. They mistreat and confuse pet owners, doubting the competence and ability of other veterinarians (their colleagues), with the attitude that only some of them know and will discover the cure for a terminal problem. All to make money. No respect for the animal or its owners.
The professionals are very attentive to the animals, and the cost-benefit ratio is very good.
Grateful for all the best things that happened to me

The two experiences I had at this hospital were incredible. On a day when there was a major emergency animal operation, they still agreed to see my cat.
The last time was by phone. My dog ​​ate chocolate-flavored cookies, and because we didn't know what time it had happened, we panicked. We called two different clinics that told us to go there because it would be necessary to hospitalize my dog. At this hospital, they asked the name of the cookies, investigated with the doctor, and explained that they were cookies with little cocoa, that it wasn't necessary to go to the vet right away, that we had to monitor her, and only go if she showed symptoms.
Meanwhile, my dog ​​didn't have any problems, she didn't even vomit.
Thank you so much for the care and concern you always show.

I went for the first time and wasn't seen because I arrived 20 minutes late. Driving in that area of ​​Porto is a hassle due to the metro construction, and even so, the person serving me wasn't understanding.
They didn't give any options, just told me to reschedule again through the website.
In my opinion, they should have made the appointment right when I was there.

My kitten was rushed to the emergency room with a urinary obstruction that subsequently required surgery, and believe me, he couldn't have been treated any better. The entire team, from doctors and nurses to assistants and even receptionists, were impeccable with us from day one!
During his hospitalization, he was always very well cared for. I received daily updates on his condition, and I can say that I visited him every day. Even the cage where they stay was always spotless—details that really matter.
Thank you for all the care, affection, and love you put into your work, which is what makes it excellent. If it weren't for you, Ruizinho wouldn't be doing as well as he is today, I'm sure of it. ❤️

Friendly and professional.
Service 10/10

I have been going to this hospital for years because I have a dog that I adopted in 2017. The service is very good. However, I want to publicly acknowledge Dr. Joana, who has solved very serious problems for me over these years with great competence, timeliness, and efficiency. She is an exceptional professional, especially in her human side. Kind, caring, understanding, and tolerant.
Thank you so much for everything, Dr. Joana.
Luiza Vasconcelos

5-star rating!!

I am grateful for the unparalleled professionalism in the care provided by Dr. Catarina Gomes and Nurse Inês who, in an urgent situation (late at night...), dedicated boundless care and medical professionalism to the treatment and monitoring of my cat Rubi.

The entire clinical process was accompanied by oral explanations!!!

Thank you very much and CONGRATULATIONS!

Maria Helena Lemos
Porto
Attentive staff and reasonable prices. Above all, they don't try to monetize people's feelings, as is common in veterinary clinics across the country.
Doesn't seem to be an emergency hospital. No one responded at the door.

They were very kind and sensitive to the premature passing of my kitten LUKE.
I sincerely appreciate their care in minimizing our pain.

The staff here handled our dear beloved cat with such care and professionalism. At the end he could not be saved but the staff and doctors were amazing and everything was handled with extreme care. The information was all given to us clearly, scientifically and objectively. This was the saddest day of my life but my dear cat was comfortable, warm and safe in their hands. We couldn't have asked for more. The way the end was handled was so caring. Thank you 🙏
No one answers the phone.
Good service with the price for all treatment is reasonable here!! Veterinarian here is very patient on your pet.

I advise no one to take their animals to this hospital because they let my dog ​​die due to medical negligence and incompetence, and to this day the explanations they have given are all contradictory!!

Professionalism, friendliness, attention – I have a dog who had two surgeries at this establishment and I only have good things to say. Doctors, assistants, nurses, thank you for the care you gave my Master.
Door closed at 11 AM on Sunday. Read and draw your own conclusions.
Door closed with a 6-hour wait time notice. Thanks for the huge waste of time, I had to go somewhere else.
Although the exotic animal veterinarian wasn't present at the time, they did everything they could to save my hamster. Without their help, my pet would have died. 🥰 …

On February 2nd, I took my Mary to see Dr. Mariana for an evaluation of her dental condition, as I noticed my kitten had bad breath. The service was very good and the team was very helpful. I can only thank them and recommend them. I was very satisfied with the care they gave Mary and was surprised to learn that she only needed to have one tooth extracted and the rest could be fixed.

I highly recommend Dr. Mariana!!

The people here are caring for their patients, highly professional in their vetinary skills and caring for us concerned family members.  I speak a bit of Portuguese but they accommodated me by speaking English.
Together we came up with a good treatment strategy that will care for my cadela.
They are ready to assist me in making an appointment with an orthopedic specialist if necessary.
Calling and emailing is a bit futile as phones either are busy or go unanswered. Emails not answered.
So I suggest that you walk in off the street.  We did at 10:00 and was seen within 15 minutes.
Cost, emergency visit, exam and meds for 68€.
Imagine this as the ordeal and cost in the US.
I highly recommend this vet hospital.
The team is super friendly and attentive. They treat our animals with great care and dedication.
They tell you to call to schedule appointments but they never answer the phone.
Excellent

Hello, I wanted to know if you could do a free procedure to remove some knots of fur from my dog. They're only on her front paws. I usually groom her at home, but it's always been difficult on her paws; she rejects any touch in that area. I've only managed to do it on her hind paws and body, always by "bribing" her with food while I do it. I haven't had the money to pay a proper veterinarian, and I feel bad leaving her like this. I do what I can at home, but it's not always easy. If you can't do it for free, please give me a price that's quite affordable. She really needs it, and to do that kind of trimming on her paws, she needs to be sedated.

Our 1.5-year-old Mini Australian Shepherd broke a canine tooth while chewing on a deer antler treat. We immediately took him to a nearby clinic, but they told us that the tooth would most likely need to be extracted, as the specialist capable of performing the necessary procedure was unavailable at the time. We were very upset and decided to look for other options. That’s how we found Hospital Veterinário da Universidade do Porto – UPVet.
Late in the evening, we contacted the clinic via their online chat, and they responded quickly, scheduling an appointment for the very next day with Dr. Mariana Monteiro. She is an exceptional specialist! After examining our dog, she confidently assured us that the tooth could be saved and that extraction wouldn’t be necessary.
Within just two hours, our pet underwent a full examination, X-rays, tooth restoration, and a professional dental cleaning. By the evening, he was already recovering from the anesthesia, and by the next day, he was back to his usual active self!
Many thanks to Dr. Mariana Monteiro and the entire UPVet team for their professionalism, care, and dedication. They are true experts in their field! We highly recommend them!
Good service, good facilities, good veterinarians. But a bit expensive.

Fantastic, from the reception to the treatment of the animals....!!!!
Price/quality/professionalism very good!!
Over time, only the costs get worse!! .... Otherwise, everything is always improving...!!!!
Once again, just amazing!!!
I loved the closeness and attention given to the Moon and even to us.

I had a little scare with my dog, I called them (she wasn't being followed there) and explained everything. They took the time to research the medications they had prescribed and help me over the phone! Very kind, attentive, and passionate about their profession! Thank you so much. And Meggy will be in good hands 🙂‍↕️💖 …

My dog ​​Javita and I were very well received. She received her vaccinations, had surgery, was spayed, and had an umbilical hernia repaired, and we only have good things to say about everyone – doctors, assistants, and receptionists. It's clear they love their profession and care for our furry friends. The prices are affordable compared to the market. I highly recommend them. I've already recommended them to friends and family, and they all loved them. I leave here my appreciation and gratitude ❤️👌🐶

My cats have always received excellent care at UPVET. However, for the past few months, and more specifically yesterday, I must express my complete dissatisfaction with the terrible telephone service I (did not) receive. It is unacceptable that I spent all day yesterday calling and was not answered; I had to go to an emergency appointment. My cat was hospitalized yesterday, and this morning they were supposed to call me to inform me of her condition. It is unacceptable that, the only time they answered, they told me that the doctor was talking to another pet owner and would call me back shortly. It's been almost two hours and I still haven't been contacted. A veterinary hospital that I even value is providing a terrible service to its patients.

Besides not responding to the online appointment booking, I took the trouble to call yesterday afternoon, the 4th, and they scheduled an appointment for the 5th at 11 am. When I arrived, they said there was no appointment scheduled. I went for a walk in Porto because the appointment didn't happen. They must not need clients. There are veterinarians who do.

My experience was very positive. My pinscher dog, Kika Maria, was treated by Dr. Joana, an excellent and extremely humane professional. She even provided excellent guidance on the paperwork and especially the clinical aspects once I returned to Brazil. My dog ​​lived a healthy and high-quality life for nine years thanks to how Dr. Joana guided Kika's entire treatment. We will always remember her fondly. The facilities are also very good, and the reception staff were always very helpful.
The veterinarians were wonderful and took great care of my cat! I'll be back :)
He's been my vet for 22 years... I even used to take my cat to the old building... they're responsible and very trustworthy.

Team of Excellent Human Beings, I have a dog who had a problem that was resolved with the utmost urgency, with complete professionalism and commendable attitude. Thank you to everyone who took care of Leah.

The phone service is a disaster!!
Rings and rings and rings, but nobody answers!!!
Sympathy

I recommend them all.
Efficiency, professionalism, and courtesy.
Helpfulness and empathy.

Good service and the prices for all services are more affordable than at any other clinic.
To Dr. Diana, my thanks for her dedication and all the treatment for my Cookie.

The veterinary doctor's service was very competent, friendly, and attentive.

The administrative staff also demonstrated competence and friendliness.

Dr Andre was very friendly, helpful and detailed when answering our questions. All the staff was friendly and professional. We were very thankful that everyone spoke English as we do not know Portuguese!

I love this place. When we moved from the US, we were concerned if we could find similar lever of veterinary care as we had in Los Angeles, but this hospital put all my concerns to rest. The vets are highly trained and competent. Above all, they care about the animals. I highly recommend.

Amazing. Super attentive and caring with the animals. Available and helpful.

I highly recommend them!

Poor service from the reception. I booked a specialist appointment (Orthopedics) several days in advance. It was scheduled for today, December 4th, at 8:30 am. I rearranged my schedule to be able to attend, as the chances of getting an earlier appointment were naturally limited. I asked them to notify me if there were any changes, and if they couldn't answer, as I am limited by my profession, to send me an email and/or text message. Today, I arrived as scheduled, 15 minutes early (around 8:15 am). I entered and stood by the reception desk for 20 minutes without anyone asking me anything. At 8:35 am, I asked if I should let them know I was waiting for my dog ​​to be called for an appointment scheduled for 8:30 am. The response: "They didn't tell you?...the appointment is at 9:30 am." I sat down and waited until 9:40 am. Nothing more was said to me. At 9:45 am I informed them that I would be leaving and I departed.
Top
The friendliness, care, and dedication of the professionals (doctors and staff), punctuality, and cleanliness of the space were all appreciated!
They never answer the phone.

My dog ​​suffers from epilepsy and is being very well cared for there. Excellent professionals, all very attentive and competent. They are always in a good mood; I believe they love what they do. In addition, they have good prices and it's a very clean place. Thank you Dr. Joana and team.

I went to accompany a friend, and I found the service excellent. Everyone was very attentive and caring with the animals, and the entire staff deserves a 10. However, I must criticize the prices, which I found very high, as well as the fact that there is no low-cost treatment available for poor people who end up not being able to afford to treat their pets.
Even so, I emphasize the 10 rating for everyone, from the receptionist to the veterinarian!!
